summary.zh: 为 shell 脚本编写 Bats 测试用例
summary.en: Write Bats test suites for shell scripts and CI

description.zh: 讲解 Bats 的用例组织、fixture 与边界条件测试写法，覆盖失败路径和多种 shell 方言。适合给脚本补测试或在 CI 中做脚本回归。需要先安装 Bats 运行器。
description.en: Explains Bats test organization, fixtures and edge-case coverage including failure paths and multiple shell dialects. Suits adding tests to scripts or CI regression. Requires the Bats runner to be installed.
